End-to-End Micro-Pilot to Cluster Autopilot

Source: R/job.R
slurm_autopilot.Rd

Executes the complete slurmpilot lifecycle in one call:

  1. Runs pilot_run() on a controlled sample slice to empirically measure startup overhead, task runtime distribution, and OS peak RSS.

  2. Calls estimate_resources() to size SLURM array chunking, --mem, and --time.

  3. Submits the full workload via slurm_submit() on backend.

  4. Optionally waits for completion, performs automatic surgical retries on failed chunks (auto-scaling --mem on OOM and --time on TIMEOUT), and collects ordered results.

Usage

slurm_autopilot(
  fun,
  args_list,
  backend,
  n_pilot = NULL,
  sample_method = c("head", "stratified", "random"),
  target_chunk_minutes = 15,
  max_array_size = 1000L,
  min_chunk_size = 1L,
  max_chunk_size = NULL,
  mem_safety = 1.35,
  time_safety = 1.5,
  cpus_per_task = 1L,
  strategy = c("contiguous", "round_robin", "lpt"),
  task_weights = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  seed = NULL,
  isolate = TRUE,
  wait = TRUE,
  auto_retry = 0L,
  retry_mem_multiplier = 1.5,
  retry_time_multiplier = 1.5,
  simplify = FALSE,
  poll_interval = 0.15,
  progress = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

fun

A function accepting a single element of args_list (fun(arg)).

args_list

Non-empty list (or vector coercible to list) of per-task arguments.

backend

A SlurmBackend object (e.g. mock_slurm_backend() or slurm_ssh_backend()).

n_pilot

Optional positive integer number of sample replications to profile. Defaults to min(length(args_list), 5L).

sample_method

Strategy for selecting pilot task indices from args_list: "head" (first n_pilot), "stratified" (evenly spaced across the workload), or "random".

target_chunk_minutes

Target walltime in minutes per SLURM array task. Default 15.

max_array_size

Maximum number of SLURM array indices allowed by the cluster (MaxArraySize). Default 1000L.

min_chunk_size

Minimum tasks per SLURM array chunk. Default 1L.

max_chunk_size

Optional maximum tasks per SLURM array chunk.

mem_safety

Multiplicative safety factor applied to predicted peak RSS. Default 1.35.

time_safety

Multiplicative safety factor applied to predicted upper walltime. Default 1.50.

cpus_per_task

Integer number of CPU threads exposed to each pilot trial (OMP_NUM_THREADS / OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS). Default 1L.

strategy

Chunk assignment strategy: "contiguous" (default), "round_robin", or "lpt" (Longest Processing Time first load balancing for heterogeneous task workloads).

task_weights

Optional positive numeric vector of length n_tasks providing relative per-task runtime/cost weights for "lpt" load balancing. When strategy = "lpt" and task_weights = NULL, weights are interpolated linearly from the pilot trials across 1:n_tasks (or fall back to uniform weights if fewer than 2 distinct pilot indices exist).

name

Optional job name.

packages

Character vector of package names to attach inside each isolated worker before executing fun.

globals

Named list of helper objects or functions made available in fun's evaluation environment.

seed

Optional integer base seed for reproducible sampling and child trial execution.

isolate

Logical; if TRUE (default), runs each trial in a fresh background R process via callr::r_bg() to measure true startup cost and isolated OS RSS. Set FALSE only for fast in-process profiling.

wait

Logical; wait for completion and collect results. Default TRUE.

auto_retry

Non-negative integer maximum automatic surgical retry rounds when chunks fail. Default 0L.

retry_mem_multiplier

Memory scale factor applied when automatically retrying OUT_OF_MEMORY chunks. Default 1.5.

retry_time_multiplier

Walltime scale factor applied when automatically retrying TIMEOUT chunks. Default 1.5.

simplify

Logical passed to slurm_collect(). Default FALSE.

poll_interval

Polling interval in seconds passed to slurm_wait(). Default 0.15.

progress

Logical; if TRUE, emits concise progress messages via cli. Default FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to slurm_submit().

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_autopilot" containing pilot, resources, job, status, and results (when wait = TRUE).

Examples

backend <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)
run <- slurm_autopilot(
  fun = function(x) x$a + x$b,
  args_list = lapply(1:6, function(i) list(a = i, b = 10)),
  backend = backend,
  n_pilot = 2L,
  max_chunk_size = 3L,
  simplify = TRUE
)
run$results
#> [1] 11 12 13 14 15 16
unlink(backend$root_dir, recursive = TRUE)
